title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Reschedule Fees: Desk Guidance and Posting Tool
content:
On a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment, a move is free only when the member asks for it at least the service level's reschedule notice days, counted in calendar days, before the delivery date then booked, and the appointment has made fewer free moves than the service level's free reschedules; whether a move had that notice is judged when it is made, and a short-notice move owes its fee at that moment.

A move already recorded on the appointment is judged by the record alone, since no request date is kept, and a recorded move within the free reschedules that carries no reschedule fee entry stands as a free move. For recorded moves that owe a fee, the fee owed for them is posted as one reschedule fee entry dated the posting date with the appointment's currently booked delivery date as its service date.

The reschedule fee owed on an appointment whose road miles exceed the included radius is not fixed until the appointment's extended-distance entry stands on it.

## The rule at a glance

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Move asked for with at least the notice days, and fewer free moves made than the free reschedules | Free |
| Move asked for with less notice | Owes its fee at the moment it is made |
| Move asked for with the notice days on an appointment that has already made as many free moves as the free reschedules | Not free |
| Move already on the record, within the free reschedules, with no reschedule fee entry | Stands as a free move |
| Recorded moves that owe a fee | One reschedule fee entry, dated the posting date, service date the currently booked delivery date |
| Road miles beyond the included radius | The fee owed is fixed once the extended-distance entry stands on the appointment |

**Hypothetical notice.** For a level with 2 notice days and a delivery date then booked for the 20th, a move asked for on the 18th has the notice; one asked for on the 19th does not.

## Posting tool: `post_reschedule_fee_c618067c`

**What it does.** Member services adds one reschedule fee entry to a member's delivery appointment for moves of its delivery date that are charged. On success the appointment's fee history shows a new reschedule fee for the amount given, posted today and tied to the appointment date given, and the amount becomes part of the delivery fees the member pays for that appointment. The appointment's date, window and move count are not changed.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks `post_reschedule_fee_c618067c` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the member who owns the appointment, as returned by the customer lookup and shown on the appointment | Identifier |
| `delivery_id` | The reference number of the delivery appointment being charged, as returned by the delivery appointment lookup | Identifier |
| `service_date` | The appointment date the fee relates to | YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, no time or time zone; never empty |
| `amount` | The reschedule fee to post, in USD | 2 decimal places, always positive; stored rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a description of the posted entry: `status` ("posted"), `delivery_charge_id` (the new fee entry's reference number), `delivery_id` (the appointment charged), `charge_type` (always `reschedule_fee`), `units` (always 1), `amount` (the fee in USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `service_date` (the appointment date the fee relates to, YYYY-MM-DD).
